blocks.goal: Extract large, cohesive private helper methods and related private static fields from org.jsoup.parser.TokeniserState into a new helper class to reduce size/complexity of the enum while preserving API and behavior.

ops.details: Create a new package-private helper class org.jsoup.parser.TokeniserStateHelper in the same package and move the listed private static helper methods and related private static fields into it as static members. Update the TokeniserState enum to invoke TokeniserStateHelper.handleDataEndTag(...), TokeniserStateHelper.readRawData(...), TokeniserStateHelper.readCharRef(...), TokeniserStateHelper.readEndTag(...), TokeniserStateHelper.handleDataDoubleEscapeTag(...), and TokeniserStateHelper.readDoctypeInternalSubset(...) and to reference the moved fields as TokeniserStateHelper.replacementChar, TokeniserStateHelper.replacementStr, TokeniserStateHelper.eof, TokeniserStateHelper.attributeNameCharsSorted, and TokeniserStateHelper.attributeValueUnquoted. Keep the methods package-private/static as in the original to preserve behaviour and not change public API. No public methods are moved. All relocated code stays in org.jsoup.parser. The extraction reduces TokeniserState size and groups helper logic in TokeniserStateHelper.

No external imports required because TokeniserStateHelper is in the same package; ensure TokeniserState references TokeniserStateHelper with fully-qualified or simple name. Adjust imports if the codebase style requires explicit import statements (none required for same package).

Replace internal calls and references inside TokeniserState to the moved helpers/fields so they call TokeniserStateHelper.<member>(...) or reference TokeniserStateHelper.<field> as needed. Example replacements: handleDataEndTag(t,r,Rawtext) -> TokeniserStateHelper.handleDataEndTag(t,r,Rawtext), and replacementChar -> TokeniserStateHelper.replacementChar. Ensure all references compile against the new helper class.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
